code_rule: implementation names stay in code; prose follows this table
drive_units: preserve exact JaxFNE quantity name where available; never imply physical current units
dynamics_grammar: drive -> response -> operating point -> perturbation -> return
gate_vs_bound: gate when pass/fail; bound for continuous safety limits

memory_terms.recurrent_dynamical_memory: qualified recurrent response mode (reserve: do not call T_R memory until residue/replication passes)

model: use model (JaxFNE public object name); plant only in explicit control-theory derivations
operating_regime: use model or operating regime instead of plant
recurrent_effect: define by intervention (FULL minus REC_OFF); symbol A_R only after definition
recurrent_substrate: keep; denotes the prerequisite circuit regime
science_grammar: JDNA -> model -> neural state X -> H -> HDP/plastic parameters Theta -> source -> field/proxy -> observation
single_column_model: replaces cortical primitive; C_min remains only as experiment/run ID

source_field_terms.field: field/proxy; bare field reserved for JaxFNE source-field-observation chain

state_terms.H: H or biophysical state H (never expand differently by context)
state_terms.Theta: plastic parameters or Theta (prose vs equations)
state_terms.X: neural state; symbol only in equations

substrate_truth_compressed: The qualified single-column operating regime has functional HDP, H-dependent plasticity allocation, and state-dependent plastic retention. It does not yet have a qualified recurrent substrate. Under zero tonic drive, the empirical return field has only a near-quiescent operating point. Recurrent-current replay is faithful, but realized recurrent excitation is ~0.01-0.06 effective drive units per E neuron versus ~3-4 required for sustained E activity. The blocker is recurrent-current magnitude/architecture, not JaxFNE current representation, HDP, or unidentified intrinsic-memory effect.

surgical_terms.funnel: zero-drive return field (funnel = informal shorthand only)
surgical_terms.hdp: HDP is the mechanism class; homeostatic controller = this Jomission rule
surgical_terms.retention_regimes: short/long retention regime (not two HDP mechanisms)
surgical_terms.tonic: tonic drive, never bare tonic in durable artifacts

unit_words.configured_realized_effective: preserve; evidence distinction, do not simplify
